content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(ITDR-011 Anomalous Bulk Remote-Wipe Broadcast from Privileged Intune Identity) AND ABIOC(ITDR-011 First-Seen Destructive Device Action on a Standing-Privilege Admin) — fuses the burst-scale and first-seen behavioral deviations on the same tenant and admin identity, correlated with that identity's preceding risky / impossible-travel sign-in, into a single identity-weaponized mass-device-wipe incident anchored to the phished-admin causality chain (phished-admin risky sign-in -> MDM console access -> tenant-scale RemoteWipe/FactoryReset broadcast).
rules.name: Identity-Weaponized Mass Device Wipe — ABIOC Causality Stitch
